name: Gabor 滤波器响应
description: 分析 multi-scale, multi-orientation 纹理模式 using Gabor滤波器s. AI images show more isotropic texture responses lacking directional variation.
algorithm: Multi-orientation Gabor Filter Bank + Anisotropy Analysis
mechanism: 应用 Gabor滤波器s at multiple orientations and 测量 energy 分布. Lower anisotropy indicates AI生成的 content.
useCase: Detecting uniform 纹理模式 in AI生成的 images

references.title: Lyu, S. & Farid, H. (2005). How Realistic is Photorealistic? IEEE TSP.
Manjunath, B.S. & Ma, W.Y. (1996). Texture Features for Browsing and Retrieval. IEEE TPAMI.
Daugman, J.G. (1985). Uncertainty Relation for Resolution in Space and Frequency. JOSA-A.

strengths:
• Multi-orientation 纹理分析 captures directional 模式
• Based on well-studied psychophysical model of human vision
• Effective at detecting isotropic AI texture 伪影
• Robust 跨 different image content types
• Tunable frequency and orientation parameters
limitations:
• 计算成本高 with large filter banks
• Parameter selection (sigma, lambda) affects results
• Natural textures with uniform orientation may cause 误报
• Resolution-dependent 分析
• Modern AI generators improving at texture diversity
